build_moe_module: build a LinearDeepseekV3MoE mixed expert module with shared experts from a DeepSeek V3 config
create_experts_forward: create a forward pass through selected experts using top-k indices and weights for hidden states
route_tokens_to_experts: route tokens to experts by computing group scores and selecting top-k experts with normalized weights
review_forward_method: review the LinearDeepseekV3MoE forward method that routes tokens through experts and adds shared expert output
refactor_expert_routing: refactor the route_tokens_to_experts method to support custom group scoring or expert selection strategies
